query:
INSERT INTO users (
            google_sub, name, given_name, family_name, picture, email, email_verified
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
            ON CONFLICT (google_sub) DO UPDATE
            SET name = $2, given_name = $3, family_name = $4, picture = $5, email = $6, email_verified = $7
